summary: Weyco Group filed an 8-K disclosing Board adoption on November 3, 2026 of an amended and restated Code of Business Ethics (Exhibit 14.1), covering directors, officers and employees including principal executive, financial and accounting officers; changes enhance conflicts-of-interest, compliance and reporting standards, with no waiver of the prior code. Item 8.01 reports the September 2026 death of former Chairman/CEO Thomas Florsheim, Sr., a director since 1964, and the Board's reduction from seven to six members, a majority still independent under Nasdaq rules. No transaction terms; no deal mechanics or arbitrage angle apply.
